description: Send a message to one of the user's own agents by its handle (the name after the @ on its page) and start a run with it. Use this when the user asks you to hand something to a named agent: '@research, what changed at Acme?'. It returns at once with a trace_id; the agent's answer takes a minute or more, so read it later with agent_reply. Pass conversation_id to keep the exchange in one thread.

conversation_id.description: The chat thread to post into. Leave it out to start a new one; the result names the thread used.

handle.description: The agent's handle, with or without the leading @.

text.description: What to ask the agent, in the user's own words.

name: message_agent
title: Message an agent
